title: Flux 2 Prompt Schema
description: JSON schema for validating Flux 2 image generation prompts produced by this skill. Supports all variants: Pro, Max, Flex, Klein, and Kontext.

prompt.description: Natural language or JSON structured prompt. Optimal length 12-25 words for simple scenes, up to 512 tokens for complex JSON prompts. Front-load key concepts in the first 5-10 words. NO negative language.

variant.description: Which Flux 2 model variant to use. Pro=production default, Max=highest quality, Flex=typography/control, Klein=speed, Kontext=character consistency.

width.description: Output width in pixels. Must be multiple of 16. Max total pixels ~4MP (width × height ≤ ~4,194,304).

height.description: Output height in pixels. Must be multiple of 16. Max total pixels ~4MP.

aspect_ratio.description: Alternative to explicit width/height. 'match_input_image' matches the first reference image's ratio.

seed.description: Seed for reproducibility. Same seed + same prompt = same result. Use ±1-5 for subtle variations.

guidance.description: [Flex variant ONLY] Controls prompt adherence. 3-5=creative freedom, 7-10=strict following. Ignored by other variants.

steps.description: [Flex variant ONLY] Inference steps. 6=fast preview, 20=balanced, 40-50=max quality/typography. Ignored by other variants.

image_urls.description: Reference images for multi-reference compositing. Pro/Max/Flex: up to 8-10, Klein: up to 4. Total input must not exceed 9MP.

image_prompt.description: [Kontext variant ONLY] Single reference image for character identity preservation.

structured_prompt.description: Optional JSON structured prompt for complex multi-subject scenes. If provided, this is serialized into the prompt field for API submission. Flux 2 natively understands JSON prompts.

color_palette.description: Global hex colors for the scene

metadata.description: Pipeline metadata. Not sent to API.

variant_rationale.description: Why this variant was selected for this generation task
